page.overview:
Who is Arabia Fats?

[http://myanimelist.net/people/10639/Manabu_Sakamaki Manabu Sakamaki] (Anime)

He is one of DIO's many subordinates, who ambushes the Joestar Group in the middle of the Arabian desert with his Stand, Sun.

Arabia Fats is a short, overweight man with short, spiky hair. He is seen wearing a T-shirt bearing a rising sun symbol, but it looks like the Macedonian flag.

His real personality is unknown; he was never shown speaking or otherwise emoting, as his only appearance had him unconscious after being struck by a rock that Star Platinum threw at him.
